question: Compare the economic opportunity index of high income, middlie income groups and the world
query: SELECT income_group, AVG(econ_opportunity_index) AS avg_econ_opportunity_index FROM global_development_indicators WHERE income_group IN ('high', 'middle') GROUP BY income_group UNION ALL SELECT 'world' AS income_group, (SELECT AVG(econ_opportunity_index) FROM global_development_indicators) AS avg_econ_opportunity_index LIMIT 50;
